incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: elevated 5xx rate and p95 latency for model omega-v2-quant in eu-west1. Error rate ~8% (baseline 0.3%). Affected prod route: /v1/generate.
ryan: ack. I'm oncall — paging @maria for SRE assist. Starting triage.
devin: looking at runtime logs, seeing repeated "kv cache invalidation" and kernel mismatches on quant path. A spike started after kernel-opt push ~45m ago.
ryan: customer-impact? any heavy keys?
naomi: support: tracking 9 active customers seeing errors; top keys: cust:acme (high QPS), cust:zephyr. CS runbook opened and sending outbound notices.
ryan: plan: cut omega-v2-quant in eu-west1, steer traffic to omega-stable (omega-v1), and apply emergency keywise quotas for heavy keys. Will also demote the quant variant to canary globally until root cause confirmed.
maria: on it. Preparing route change and quota slices. Handing pager to me in 25m if ryans stays on follow-ups.
ryan: please execute traffic shift when ready. I'll coordinate customers and watch metrics.
deploy-bot: queued route change: promote model=omega-stable region=eu-west1 weight=100; demote model=omega-v2-quant region=eu-west1 weight=0. Confirm to apply?
maria: applying now. command:
```
redwoodctl route set --region eu-west1 --from omega-v2-quant --to omega-stable --weight 100 --force
redwoodctl quota set --region eu-west1 --scope keywise --keys cust:acme,cust:zephyr --limit 10rps
```
deploy-bot: route change applied at 2953624935. omega-v2-quant -> 0% (eu-west1). omega-stable -> 100% (eu-west1). Quota change applied.
devin: immediate telemetry: error rate fell from 8% -> 0.6% within 30s, p95 latency down from 780ms -> 120ms. KV-corruption traces subsided. Preliminary: quant kernel path to blame.
naomi: update sent to impacted customers, noting mitigation (traffic routed to stable variant) and ETA for follow-up. No major customer downtime reported, degraded responses observed.
ryan: good. I'll open an incident ticket and link to rollback/patch playbook. Creating INC-4321. Assigning to runtime team for root cause and to coord quant revert.
maria: demoted omega-v2-quant to canary globally and removed it from prod routing. Created roll-forward block until runtime fix verified. I'll hold pager for next 30m and monitor health and key quotas.
devin: collecting full flamegraphs and kernel diffs, will share artifact link in ticket in 15m.
ryan: thanks everyone. Next actions: 1) runtime triage (devin) 2) postmortem and customer impact analysis (naomi/maria) 3) decide on re-enable timeline after kernel rollback or patch. Handing off pager to maria at 2953625075. :thumbsup:
maria: ack — taking pager. Monitoring dashboards and will escalate to infra kernel owners if errors reappear.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — routing change successful, key quotas in place, monitoring for 1h.
ryan: leaving channel; reachable if needed.
maria: closing thread after 1h stable window or earlier if rollback validated.
_meta: generated for dataset: slack incidents thread about disabling a problematic model variant, routing to stable, keywise quotas, oncall handoff, and customer coordination
